name: Redact
tagline: Files your removal requests with the data brokers so you need not pay a service
description: Your address and phone number sit on dozens of people-search sites, each one with its own buried removal form. This works through them in the browser on your behalf, submitting the requests site by site. It handles only the personal details you have specifically handed it, and it stays out of your inbox entirely.
author: PyRo1121
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
